# transcdr_connection (Data Source)

A connection by id or by name, e.g. one made in the dashboard, to use as an automation's source, destination or trigger. Secrets are never returned. Needs `connections:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A connection made outside this configuration (in the dashboard, or by
# another team's Terraform), looked up by its exact name. Use `id` instead
# when names are not unique. Secrets are never returned.
data "transcdr_connection" "ingest" {
  name = "Ingest bucket"
}

# Watch it without managing it here.
resource "transcdr_automation" "watch" {
  name   = "Watch ingest"
  source = { connection_id = data.transcdr_connection.ingest.id }
  preset = "hls-av1-abr"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) `con_…`. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) The connection's name. Give this or `id`; it must match exactly one connection.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (Object) `source`, `destination`, `watch`, `trigger`, `events`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `class` (String) `storage` or `messaging`.
- `config` (Attributes) The non-secret settings (see the `transcdr_connection` resource). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why it was turned off.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection is on.
- `failure_count` (Number) Transient failures in a row.
- `kind` (String) The connection's kind, e.g. `s3` or `sqs`.
- `last_error` (String) The last test's error.
- `secrets_set` (Set of String) The names of the stored secrets.
- `status` (String) `untested`, `ok` or `error`.
